answer: An attacker can wander across a thousand forged identities, but PoA makes each one pay at the ledge: before an agent may attest, five non-kin peers must independently grade its reasoning as novel. Copy one answer across your Sybil mesa and the duplicate is rejected on-ledger; forge distinct judgment per clone and you've spun up a thousand genuine reasoners—the exact cost you tried to dodge. Sybil-resistance isn't bought with capital here, it's extracted in non-counterfeitable thought.
